_comment: EGM Downloader Windows update feed. Upload to egerena.com/apps/egm-version.json
_version_notes: Robustness: settings, history, and cookies now written atomically — no file corruption on crash or power loss mid-write
Fix: strict image format detection on cached thumbnails — unknown formats rejected instead of mis-tagged as JPG; WAV-tagged-as-WebP stops happening
Fix: Content-Type header validated before reading thumbnail body — non-image responses close immediately without consuming bandwidth

notes: Robustness: settings, history, and cookies now written atomically — no file corruption on crash or power loss mid-write
Fix: strict image format detection on cached thumbnails — unknown formats rejected instead of mis-tagged as JPG; WAV-tagged-as-WebP stops happening
Fix: Content-Type header validated before reading thumbnail body — non-image responses close immediately without consuming bandwidth
Fix: placeholder text and section labels now use theme-aware color across all 238 themes — closes v0.99.11 known issue
Security: signed update manifests — ed25519 signature verified on every update check before any content is trusted; unsigned or tampered manifests silently rejected

Security: structured security event logging — all security-relevant events (token mismatch, host rejection, checksum failure, path traversal, thumbnail URL rejection, manifest verification failure) logged to console and rotating DATA_DIR/logs/security.log
Quality: unit test suite — 17 tests covering cross-platform parity, security boundaries, and historical regressions; wired into GitHub Actions CI (runs on every push to main)

New: 67 themes added — Puerto Rico Collection (22 themes celebrating Ponce, the island, holidays, icons, and culture), Team Easter Eggs (5 themes named after the team behind EGM), and category expansion (cities, space, movies, retro, music, moods, architecture, food, weather)
New: dedicated Puerto Rico section in the themes sidebar with flag identifier
Polish: 36 themes received contrast readability improvements (text2 and log-text bumps; Savathûn identity rework; Valhalla palette differentiation from N64)
Fix: themes window sidebar no longer scrolls away with the page — sidebar and grid scroll independently at any theme count
Security: thumbnail fetching restricted to HTTPS-only; rejects file://, ftp://, http:// schemes (defense-in-depth, documented in SECURITY.md)
Docs: SECURITY.md updated with documented threat-model decision for thumbnail CDN fetching
Trust: .vbs launcher removed; portable now code-signed alongside installer — fewer SmartScreen warnings, no antivirus false positives.
Known Issues: Some placeholder text and section labels may have low contrast on certain themes. A fix is ready and will ship in the next release.

New: video thumbnails on download history — locally cached, shown in hamburger list (cropped) and expanded history (blurred fill for vertical videos); fallback icons for audio and pre-thumbnail entries
New: per-video thumbnail cleanup on history delete, bulk cleanup on cache clear
Fix: single-download audio quality selector now offers full format options (MP3 128/192/320, FLAC, M4A 256, OPUS 128/192) matching the Download All modal — respects saved default

Note: audio quality is the target output — actual quality is bounded by source. Selecting MP3 320 kbps from a source that only offers 128 kbps gives you an MP3 file at the source's actual quality. Format conversion (MP3/FLAC/OPUS) always works as selected.
New: splash redesign — replaced progress bar with spinning indicator and pulsing dots; visually consistent across all startup scenarios including ffmpeg/Deno reinstall
Polish: settings folder hint label removed from header
New: 30 themes added — Eras & Decades (10), Mythology (10), International Seasonal (10); 29 contrast readability fixes; alphabetical sort in themes window
New: Advanced panel moved to dedicated third tab on hamburger menu — main window decluttered, all settings accessible via History/Themes/Advanced tabs
Fix: auto-update check no longer fires when the toggle is off — removed unconditional 3-second timer that bypassed the setting
Security: updateSplash escape chain hardened — backslash, single quote, carriage return, and Unicode line terminators now properly escaped; progress value clamped 0-100
Polish: splash progress bar shimmer animation — subtle sweep effect indicates activity during backend startup

New: 20 themes added across 4 new categories — Food & Drink (Espresso, Matcha, Honey, Merlot, Saffron), Weather (Golden Hour, Overcast, Northern Lights, Thunderstorm, Sirocco), Space (Nebula, Pulsar, Solar Flare, Event Horizon, Andromeda), Architecture (Brutalist, Art Deco, Blueprint, Marble, Gothic)
